data.body: HOLISTIC-REVIEW FINDING I3 (opus audit, 2026-06-03): scope MQ-5 as DUAL-MODE / transition-tolerant, NOT a hard flip to MQ-only. check-ruleset-preflight.sh is set -euo pipefail and runs at sprint Phase A; it currently hard-asserts the staged-* sub-PR ruleset + check-staged-head + llm-review-on-main and exits 1 on any miss. A hard flip to MQ-only assertions would fail every sprint Phase A in the window between MQ-5 landing and MQ-6a provisioning the live queue (live state is still two-tier) — recreating exactly the wedge MQ-3 was re-scoped to avoid. Mirror tests/scripts/test-ruleset-design-invariants.sh: discriminate on presence of a live merge_queue rule on the MAIN ruleset, FAIL-CLOSED to two-tier. Then MQ-5 lands independently and safely under the still-active two-tier flow, and MQ-6 doesn't have to carry preflight changes.
